findings.issue: DNS fallback accepts local/private numeric aliases and root-dotted local names as cloud hosts: exact grants 127.1, 127.0.0.01, 0x7f.1, 10.0.0.01, localhost., host.local. and host.internal. make active() false with a busy foreground. Numeric inet_aton replay independently maps the first three to 127.0.0.1 and the fourth to 10.0.0.1. Malformed DNS such as api..example.test and names with spaces also passes. This violates the declared local/unknown-target foreground-yield boundary.
findings.fix_hint: Normalize the optional DNS root dot before local suffix checks; validate canonical DNS labels and FQDN syntax; keep strict ipaddress global checks for IP literals; reject noncanonical numeric/hex IPv4 aliases. Add a parameterized regression matrix.

findings.issue: _learning_clients resolves the current ModelClientPool client each time, while LearningPlane._try_execute captures a client retained by the in-flight worker. The installed refresh executor can replace_registry and retire the cache without replacing in-flight clients. With extraction disabled, a local reflection started while foreground is idle can keep running after the pool is refreshed to a granted cloud client and foreground becomes busy; the probe checks the new cloud object and misses the actual local transport.
findings.fix_hint: Bind independence to the exact client used by the worker. A narrowly scoped startup reflection client and target shared by the probe and LearningPlane resolver in explicit-grant mode is sufficient; keep the no-grant path unchanged, resolution errors conservative, and document Learning reload semantics. Test actual factory wiring and memory-extraction execution.
